flags: +4.6% vs day before and +30.0% vs same day last month (a Sunday, so not a like-for-like weekday baseline). Revenue-table quantity (21,443) is within 1% of the view count.

Within thresholds (1.69x day before; anomaly trigger is 2x). However, roughly 3,070 of yesterday's 6,235 appear to be the same bulk-activation spike seen in SmartConnect (3 stores) and are NOT in DIM or Merge — see DIM Alignment and SmartConnect checks. Treat this green with caution.
Active vs DIM differs by 3,073 and Active vs Merge by 3,070 — both far above the 300 threshold. DIM and Merge agree closely (gap of 3).

The ~3,070 excess in Active matches almost exactly the ~3,073 excess in SmartConnect concentrated in three stores (Fashion Fusion Elloff Street, Fashion Fusion Port Shepstone, A5 Cash and Carry Mthatha, ~1,025 each). Most likely a bulk activation load at those stores that reached SmartConnect and Active but not DIM/Merge. Needs Data/Ops confirmation: genuine sales, or a test/bulk load?

7,460 — well above the 3,000 RED threshold, and up 47.5% from 5,057 on the last run (5 Oct). Large step-change in 2 days; worth checking whether a batch of accounts crossed the 60-day mark or the view logic changed.

Three stores account for 3,073 of the excess: Fashion Fusion Elloff Street (1,035 SC vs 10 Merge), Fashion Fusion Port Shepstone (1,044 vs 19), A5 Cash and Carry Mthatha (1,038 vs 15). ~1,000+ activations in one day at a single store is far above their normal volume — likely a bulk/test load.
Smaller SC > Merge gaps: The Unlimited (+14), SPAR Kranskop (+2), SPAR Richards Bay (+2), SPAR Esikhawini (+1). Build It, Midas and Pet Pool & Home stores all match exactly.
Merge > SC (offsetting): Spot Connect App (0 vs 43), Mobile Store (47 vs 63), Spot Connect (0 vs 10), Uconnect (9 vs 17).
